Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.27.9:

- Agent Compatibility (Step 7): clicking Edit now also makes the DSPM + FDC section editable. The detected agent version becomes an editable field (manual override that sticks after you leave edit mode; clear it to fall back to auto-detect), and the FDC findings can be added, reworded, re-severitied or removed — with a 'Reset to auto' button. OS / Office selections were already editable. All edits drive the version-support verdicts and flow into the exported report.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
